marketplace.name: gaisser-agents
marketplace.description: Agent teams you call by domain. Every team ships in one plugin, each with its own subagents and one entry skill that runs them. Four teams ship today: a software team (architect, engineer, test engineer), a content team (scout, writer, designer, brand, QA), a product team (discovery, spec, UX, reviewer), and a game team (designer, programmer, technical artist, QA, network engineer). Two bridge skills connect them: `product-to-build` and `ship-to-content`.
